en-US.description: Screen capture, file sharing and productivity tool
en-US.longDescription: ShareX is a free and open source program that lets you capture or record any area of your screen and share it with a single press of a key. It also allows uploading images, text or other types of files to many supported destinations you can choose from.
en-US.name: ShareX
en-US.releaseNotes:
- Added "Task view mode" option to switch the main window task list between "List view" and "Thumbnail view" (Application settings -> Main window).
- Added "Image preview visibility" option to show the selected image beside the list view (Application settings -> Main window).
- Added "Spacing" options with a live preview for the sidebar, menus, tool menus and settings windows, and a "Compact mode" preset that brings back the ShareX v21 spacing (Application settings -> Theme).
- ShareX now asks which icon pack to use after updating.
- The "Legacy" icon pack now also covers the screen recorder bar, tool windows and image effects.
- Added a "Ruler" tool that works like the ShareX v21 ruler. The existing ruler tool is renamed to "Measure".
- Image editor improvements:
  - Added "X Canvas size" tool. Drag the frame outward to add space or inward to crop, with a selectable fill color for the added area.
  - Added "Auto-expand canvas when text or shapes go beyond the edge" option (Task settings -> Tools -> Image editor).
  - Added "Freehand arrow" option to the freehand tool.
  - Added "Rounded corners" option to the arrow tool.
  - Added "Secondary" keyboard shortcuts for toolbar tools, defaulting to the ShareX v21 numpad keys (Task settings -> Region capture -> Customize toolbar).
- Region capture now shows the position and size of the hovered window or region, using the ShareX v21 "X: Y: W: H:" format.
- Screen recording changes:
  - Added "HDR tone mapping" option so recordings on HDR displays are no longer blown out (Task settings -> Screen recorder).
  - The screen recorder bar is now also shown before FFmpeg recordings.
  - Regions too large for H.264 are now recorded as HEVC instead of failing.
- The after capture window is now goal based. Choose what ends up on the clipboard, and the tasks that goal needs are selected automatically while every other task stays an optional extra.
- Added "Just once" option to the screenshot delay menu so the delay only applies to the next capture.
- Added "Don't remind me again" option to the file delete confirmation. It can be turned back on with "Ask for confirmation before deleting files" (Application settings -> Advanced).

zh-CN.longDescription: ShareX 是一款免费的开放源代码程序，帮助您截取或录制屏幕上的任何区域，并可以一键共享。它还可以将图像、文本或其它类型的文件上传到许多支持的地方。
zh-CN.name: ShareX
